summary: Iteration 52 - NFC Tag Writing Feature Testing Complete. All backend endpoints working (POST /api/members/{id}/nfc-write with director+ restriction, 403 for staff, auto-add to profile, logging). Frontend UI verified: Write NFC button visible in badge dialogs for director+ users, UserEditDialog NFC tab shows Write NFC Tag section for director+ only.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/members/{id}/nfc-write correctly uses require_director dependency (role level 8+)
NFC write endpoint auto-adds tag to member profile if not present, marks existing tags as written
NFC write logs to nfc_write_log collection for audit trail
Duplicate serial check returns 409 conflict on write attempt
UnifiedBadge.jsx correctly shows Write NFC button only when canWriteNfc=true AND badge is staff type (STAFF_TYPES set)
AdminPage passes canWriteNfc based on currentUser?.role being director+
UserEditDialog shows Write NFC Tag section only for isDirectorPlus roles
Web NFC API (NDEFReader) used for actual tag writing - browser API, not mockable in headless tests
